name: Insight Meditation
summary:
Discover the power of mindfulness with Insight Meditation VR, your gateway to deep relaxation and inner peace. Designed for both beginners and experienced meditators, this app offers a fully immersive meditation experience in breathtaking virtual environments.

Key Features:
✅ Immersive VR Meditation: Escape into serene nature, space, and artistic landscapes.
✅ Guided & Silent Sessions: Choose from expert-led meditations or enjoy quiet contemplation.
